description: Usines hydroélectriques concédées en Provence Alpes Côte d'Azur is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.geo-ide.application.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. La région PACA est la troisième région française en termes de puissance hydraulique installée et de production d’électricité d’origine hydroélectrique (15% de la production française). Coverage: FR. Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2017-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
